whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Roti Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 3.8★ reviews with over 2,200 happy diners on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and food delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, authentic menu showcase, aur special family dining highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/roti

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Roti Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Roti Restaurant on Boring Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your popular dining menu right opposite A N College. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
